value.name: invoke mother's letter
value.description: The characters refer to a letter from Lucia's mother as something that can reveal and preserve her love.
evidence: with every word of that letter, we can stitch together the love your mother left behind and shield it from those who would tear it apart.

value.name: Lucia demands the truth
value.description: Lucia insists on learning what her mother wanted and refuses to let Daniel's plans erase the family's heart.
evidence: I need to know what she wanted, Rosa; I can’t let Daniel’s plans erase the heart of our family.
We owe it to her to uncover the truth.

value.name: Rosa proposes joint investigation
value.description: Rosa urges Lucia to uncover the truth together and frames the box as a source of clues to their mother's heart.
evidence: Then let us uncover it together, Lucia; this box may hold the keys to her heart, and we will guard that truth with every stitch of our resolve.

value.name: Lucia agrees to open the box
value.description: Lucia decides to open the box and honor her mother's wishes by reclaiming the love that built the home.
evidence: Let’s open it, Rosa; whatever we find, it’s time to honor her wishes and reclaim the love that built this home.

value.name: Rosa warns of hidden significance
value.description: Rosa cautions Lucia that the contents of the box are a testament to their mother's love and should be faced bravely.
evidence: whatever lies within this box is not just paper or fabric; it’s a testament to her love for us—let's face it together with courage.

value.name: Lucia fears the revelation
value.description: Lucia admits her fear that the box could change everything, but resolves to confront its contents.
evidence: I can feel my heart racing, Rosa; whatever is in this box could change everything for us, but we have to be ready to face it head-on.

value.name: Rosa frames house as mother's heart
value.description: Rosa says the family house embodies their mother's heart and must be protected together.
evidence: this house is her heart, and we must protect it together.

value.name: Lucia prepares to uncover secrets
value.description: Lucia steels herself to discover the secrets her mother left behind and let her spirit guide them.
evidence: I’m ready, Rosa; let’s see what secrets she left behind and allow her spirit to guide us as we honor her legacy.

value.name: Rosa urges courage
value.description: Rosa encourages Lucia to breathe deeply and trust their mother's spirit to guide them through the darkness.
evidence: Then take a deep breath, Lucia; together we will unveil her wishes and let her spirit light the way through this darkness.

value.name: Lucia vows to preserve memory
value.description: Lucia promises to weave her mother's memory into the future and not let fear silence that love.
evidence: Together, we’ll weave her memory into our future, and I won’t let fear silence the love she left for us.

value.name: Rosa affirms shared resolve
value.description: Rosa concludes that their mother's love will strengthen them and remain woven into the home as they continue forward.
evidence: her love is our strength, and with each discovery, we’ll ensure her spirit remains woven into this home, guiding us for
